sentences.text: What if you were aboard the Titanic when it struck that fatal iceberg?
Typically, only about one-tenth of an iceberg floats above the water surface.
The British liner strikes ice and begins foundering in the North Atlantic.
The ship carries lifeboats for only one-third of the people on board.
Many passengers and crew make their last stand on the raised poop deck.
Victims are plunged into freezing sea water at minus 2 degrees Celsius.
Cold shock triggers uncontrolled rapid breathing, gasping, and severe heart strain.
Within 15 to 30 minutes, cold incapacitation shuts down limb muscles, preventing swimming.
Would you have found a place in one of the few lifeboats?
